actions.reason: K3_C0001 has an interpretable biological identity (immune/inflammatory RNA program with NES ~2.1-2.6, fdr_q=0.001; BAP1 mutation enrichment OR 7.88 within the driver panel), but identity alone does not establish independent membership. Evidence directly bearing on its boundary is weak: current-label alignment shows only weak, modality-dependent separation (silhouette 0.079-0.130 in CT/RNA/WSI and -0.007 in WXS), and the partition-scope structural diagnostic reported uniformly low, nearly indistinguishable within- and between-set fused affinities. A material alternative explanation also remains: tissue source site (Cramer's V ~0.59), CT scanner model, CT slice thickness, and CT z-spacing all show candidate-specific associations surviving multiplicity control, so measured acquisition/site factors plausibly contribute to the observed structure. With membership independence unsupported and a plausible technical/site alternative unresolved, K3_C0001 is not retained as an independent discovery-stage candidate.

K3_C0002 has an interpretable biological identity (metabolic/secretory RNA program with NES ~2.0-2.9, fdr_q=0.001; PBRM1 and VHL mutation depletion within the driver panel), but identity alone does not establish independent membership. Evidence directly bearing on its boundary is weak: current-label alignment shows only weakly positive silhouettes across all four modalities (0.013-0.074) with small within-between gaps, and the partition-scope structural diagnostic reported uniformly low, nearly indistinguishable fused affinities. A material alternative explanation also remains: tissue source site, CT manufacturer, CT scanner model, CT reconstruction kernel, CT slice thickness, and CT z-spacing all show candidate-specific associations surviving multiplicity control, several with large magnitudes (Cramer's V ~0.45-0.59; epsilon-squared ~0.23-0.26). With membership independence unsupported and a plausible technical/site alternative unresolved, K3_C0002 is not retained as an independent discovery-stage candidate.

K3_C0003 has an interpretable biological identity (downward immune/metabolic RNA program with NES ~-1.8 to -2.1, fdr_q=0.001), but identity alone does not establish independent membership. Evidence directly bearing on its boundary is weak to absent: current-label alignment shows silhouette weakly positive only in RNA (0.062) and essentially zero or slightly negative in CT, WSI, and WXS, with within-set distance below between-set distance only in RNA, and the partition-scope structural diagnostic reported uniformly low, nearly indistinguishable fused affinities. A material alternative explanation also remains: tissue source site (Cramer's V ~0.46), CT phase, CT manufacturer, CT slice thickness, and CT z-spacing all show candidate-specific associations surviving multiplicity control. With membership independence unsupported and a plausible technical/site alternative unresolved, K3_C0003 is not retained as an independent discovery-stage candidate.
